notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard HLAcurrentFDD federation MOM surface after FOM composition. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, base and extension FOM modules, standard MIM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies standard federation MOM discovery, current-FDD reflection, transportation reporting, request/update behavior, and composed FOM refresh. The extension declarations are also requested and resolved by class/attribute name after the module-supplying federate resigns, while the federation remains active. No provider-specific registry, header, or implementation behavior is asserted; this is bounded development evidence, not conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador composed-FOM federation MOM lookup, subscription, identity, transportation query, and value-request services with FederateAmbassador discovery, reflection, and transportation-report callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador HLAcurrentFDD declarations
